translations.web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
translations.bsb: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
translations.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
translations.asv: Now I praise you that ye remember me in all things, and hold fast the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
